summary: Father, with Rosa Gallo, of Francesca Angelina Ferlaino, baptized in 1797; probably John's 6th-great-grandfather.
bio: Giuseppe Antonio Ferlaino and his wife Rosa Gallo were the parents of Francesca Angelina Ferlaino, baptized on 25 February 1797. That daughter has been identified as the woman later known as Agostina or Faustina Ferlaino, John's ancestor, which would make Giuseppe Antonio John's 6th-great-grandfather. The identification is probable rather than certain.
sources: [R4-S1] San Mango d'Aquino (CZ), parish of San Tommaso d'Aquino, Battesimi 1767-1808 (Book 6), image 214, p. 418, no. 9; volunteer index 'Indici Battesimi - San Mango D'Aquino Church.xlsx' (ItalianParishRecords.org, San Mango d'Aquino page; indexers incl.
